name: EPIC 201504201
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 11.9 solar radii and 0.79 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 201504201 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.868322 (16th-84th percentiles 11.489495-12.517081), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 201504201: GALAH DR3 effective temperature 4946.1343 +/- 109 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 201504201 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2999.414062 (16th-84th percentiles 2932.1875-3091.289062), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = -0.00 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; GALAH measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,999 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.79 solar masses and 11.9 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,946 K at its surface.
